title: Pack Builder meta-schema — candidate taxonomy.json
description: Validates Pack Builder candidate taxonomy.json when taxonomy is required. Full top-level branches: axes, canonical_keys, axis_to_signal_map, dispositions, internal_axes (+ identity). Contour2 axes are FREE pack-defined unique strings (minItems 1) — MUST NOT lock to 13 (D-SSR-11 / SSR-31 / GPT-PB-08). dispositions ∈ LABEL_DISPOSITION_VALUES. internal_axes MUST be ⊆ axes (document + Pack Builder enforce; gateway rejects violations at load). Tallinn exemplar = short axis list — not full Contour2 catalog. Protocol: gateway wins on federation drift; MUST NOT rewrite Module-1 process.

axes.description: Ordered list of Contour2 taxonomy axis ids — FREE pack-defined non-empty unique strings. MUST NOT require exactly 13 or enum to TAXONOMY_AXIS_VALUES (post D-SSR-11). Tallinn-minimal may list a few axes only.
axes.$comment: GPT-PB-08 T01 · free axes · MUST NOT lock-to-13 · uniqueItems

canonical_keys.description: Map axis_id → array of {key, meaning} (or equivalent objects). Full branch MUST exist; tallinn exemplar keeps 1–3 keys per shown axis.

axis_to_signal_map.description: Map axis_id → wire/signal field path or name.

internal_axes.description: Internal/non-resident axes. MUST exist (MAY be empty). Every entry MUST be ∈ axes[] (subset); Pack Builder primary/repair MUST enforce ⊆ — JSON Schema cannot cross-reference array membership; gateway resolver.py L307–310 rejects violations at load.
internal_axes.$comment: GPT-PB-08 T03 · internal_axes ⊆ axes · uniqueItems · soft PB-09 checklist
